name: MMDemo Relation Graph Contract
purpose: provide a fully traversable synthetic DWH relation graph whose operational records reconcile to the MMDemo Q3/2026 company summary

namespace.rule: all synthetic demo identities and demo relation identities remain isolated from canonical semantic identities

entityShape.typeRule: type references an existing semantic class/Universal label where used; demo IDs do not redefine that class

rules: source and target must resolve to graph entities
relation meaning is never inferred from proximity, object shape or display order

checks: all demo relation IDs use mmdemo.rel.*
monthly sales, COGS, gross margin and purchases
monthly employee hours and payroll gross
inventory bridge from opening valuation through StockMovement values
strategy Q3 sales and gross-margin measurements
reconciliation.rule: CI must fail if graph and summary cease to reconcile

behavior: traverse explicit outgoing and incoming relations

authorityRules: the demo graph is synthetic instance data, not canonical AIGMos semantic evidence
canonical MetaModule or Universal definitions are never derived from demo record shape
aggregate cards are derived/checkable views over graph-backed operational data where modeled
Strategy demo records link to operational Measurement evidence where available
